statement: For every group G with an actual connected CW classifying space of dimension at most two, put nu=max(aleph_0,d(H_1(G;Z)),rank H_2(G;Z)). For every nonidentity g in G there is a surjective homomorphism p_g:G->Q_g with p_g(g) nonidentity and |Q_g|<=nu^(aleph_0). Thus countable first and second integral homology gives residual quotient cardinal bound 2^(aleph_0).

notes: Constructs a nu-cell pi_1-injective aspherical homology core containing any specified nonidentity element, an actual one-vertex relative cellular isomorphism, countable closed blocks using full cell supports and inverse-boundary supports, a group E of size<=nu solving every finite nonsingular system, U=E^N/E^(N), and a compatible transfinite homomorphism preserving the core. The proof does not settle the countable-quotient bound in the interval aleph_0<=mu<2^(aleph_0).
